description: Reviewed UK local-area support-floor exclusions and signed families that bind despite those floors. Every entry carries measured evidence and an in-force adjudication.

local_authority/E06000053.reason: Reviewed exclusion of the local-authority support floor for Isles of Scilly (E06000053): population-proportional ladder assignment gives the area 24 positive-weight rows at the ruled K=15 (ESS 8.1 on the R17 release candidate; 7 rows at K=4 and 17 at K=10, microcosm#761 receipts section R1, identical on spine-i and spine-k), so the 50-row / ESS-50 / 50-source floor is unreachable by clone count. The area stays in the solve with its measured support and is flagged support_below_floor in area_support_summary.csv; consumers must treat its estimates as unsupported. Re-measured on every candidate; a passing area retires this entry (a stale exclusion fails the gate). Per microcosm#762 A14 the authority's own local-authority cells are signed-deferred (`local_authority_support_floor_excluded`).

local_authority/E09000001.reason: Reviewed exclusion of the local-authority support floor for City of London (E09000001): population-proportional ladder assignment gives the area 72 positive-weight rows at the ruled K=15 (ESS 11.0 on the R17 release candidate; 14 rows at K=4 and 49 at K=10, microcosm#761 receipts section R1, identical on spine-i and spine-k), so the measured ESS of 11.0 fails the ESS-50 floor even though 72 rows clear the 50-row floor. This receipt does not establish whether the separate 50-source floor passes or how further cloning would affect ESS. The area stays in the solve with its measured support and is flagged support_below_floor in area_support_summary.csv; consumers must treat its estimates as unsupported. Re-measured on every candidate; a passing area retires this entry (a stale exclusion fails the gate). Per microcosm#762 A14 the authority's own local-authority cells are signed-deferred (`local_authority_support_floor_excluded`).

census_households.reason: The 1,011-cell ons.census.households family is the per-grain A15 denominator. Deferring E06000053 or E09000001 would open the 361-cell local-authority surface and move its factor; those areas remain support-floor-excluded for every other family.
